title: The Entrance Exam
description: The Circle boards and feeds every student it takes, and half of last year's intake left owing us. Go to the Crossroads shrine and draw essence with the spell I taught you. Then do it again where I can watch.

objectives.description: Tell Elara why the Circle should spend on you
Draw arcane essence at the Crossroads shrine, three times
objectives.notes: Use the Detect Magic spell Elara taught you to find essence nodes

objectives.description: Draw it again in front of Elara

notes: Threat: none yet - this is the door, not the danger. Giver motive: every apprentice the Circle takes on is boarded and taught at the Athenaeum's expense, and Elara answers to the council for what that coin buys; a stranger who wastes the investment costs her standing as much as gold. Consequence: fail and she cuts her losses on the spot - no second attempt is written or wired. First quest in Arcane Circle guild chain; player becomes Novice rank.
